item.title: Eva Marie Saint, Oscar Winner for ‘On the Waterfront,’ Is Dead at 102
item.description: A luminous beauty with dramatic depth, she brought a layered intensity to harrowing roles and seduced Cary Grant in the romantic thriller “North by Northwest.”
item.dc:creator: Aljean Harmetz
item.media:description: Eva Marie Saint and Cary Grant in Alfred Hitchcock’s “North by Northwest” in 1959. She said some of the easiest work in her entire professional life involved the many retakes required to film their kissing scenes.

item.title: 10 Great Eva Marie Saint Performances to Stream

item.title: Alejandro G. Iñárritu Knows That ‘Digger’ Is Polarizing. That’s the Point.
item.description: Alejandro G. Iñárritu knows that “Digger” is polarizing. “I prefer that to the lukewarm reception,” he says of the climate-change satire with Tom Cruise.
item.dc:creator: Melena Ryzik and Sinna Nasseri
item.media:description: “Digger” is “a provoking film,” Alejandro G. Iñárritu conceded. “That’s the role of a film for me — let’s start the conversation.”

item.title: Paramount Closes Merger With Warner Bros. Discovery to Form Skydance
item.description: After a legal battle, the two Hollywood giants have become one. But the new company is saddled with debt, and in a memo to employees, its leaders hinted at cost cuts.
item.dc:creator: Benjamin Mullin
item.media:credit: Mark Abramson for The New York Times
item.media:description: The new company, called Skydance, will combine Warner Bros. and Paramount Pictures, as well as news networks and streaming services.
